title: [Master]-"Your license does not grant you the following permissions on TableData 17 G/L Entry: Modify" if you Update Registers from G/L Registers page for old entries with G/L Register No. = 0.
summary: Fixes a license permission error on modifying G/L Entry (table 17) that appeared when running Update Registers from the G/L Registers page for old entries whose G/L Register No. is 0. The fix is in table 45 G/L Register in the W1, ES and APAC layers.
key_points: Update Registers on the G/L Registers page no longer fails with a missing Modify permission on G/L Entry
Affects old G/L entries that have G/L Register No. = 0
Same small change applied to table 45 G/L Register in the W1, ES and APAC layers
